findings.message: The period filter of listaAvisos (dataInicio/dataFim of qryListarMeusAvisos) has no state in the defs; added public states filtroDataInicio and filtroDataFim, published by qryListarMeusAvisos itself (arguments dataInicio, dataFim).

qryAvisoPorId returns aviso but no state has it as source; its output is written into avisoAtual (the state of organism avisoDoDia) and selectedAvisoVencimento, and selectAvisoVencimento(id|null) was added as the public selection method.
Clearing the selection (null) cannot restore the latest notice without reloading the page request, so avisoAtual keeps the notice last shown; the page may call qryPaginaMeusAvisos to reset it.
public filtroDataFim is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public filtroDataInicio is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selectAvisoVencimento is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
